target: 工具用途与讨论话题：动作、对象和主体
skill: 工具用途与讨论话题：动作、对象和主体
q: A repair cooperative lends a "bridge kit", a spare wheel that riders return when their damaged wheel is ready. Skills clinics also let members exchange repair methods. What does the evidence establish about the bridge kit?
o: It gives members a place to exchange methods of wheel repair.
Temporary equipment keeps riders moving during wheel repairs.
It records views on the methods taught at the repair clinics.
A bridge-kit forum lets members debate which repairs are best.

exp.trans: 维修合作社把备用车轮称为bridge kit，借给顾客直到原车轮修好；技能课另外提供交流维修方法的机会。关于备用车轮能确定什么？
exp.structure: lends与return构成临时借用关系；when从句限定归还时间。Skills clinics是另一个承担交流功能的主体，不能把它的动作转给bridge kit。
exp.other: cooperative合作社；spare备用的；clinic在此指技能指导课。
exp.meaning: 正确概括可用temporary equipment同义改写spare wheel；保留repair、methods等词却把借用设备换成讨论工具，是动作和角色偷换。
exp.rest: place to exchange与forum把实体备用轮当成讨论场所；records views把交流或记录功能添加给车轮。提到维修这一共同话题不够。

target: 比较动作对象和工具所支持的任务
skill: 比较动作对象和工具所支持的任务
q: A conductor marks player availability on "section cards" and places them in a room-and-time grid to prevent rehearsal clashes. Players suggest new repertoire at a separate meeting. What is the role of the cards?
o: They provide a topic for sharing opinions about new music.
They record which new pieces players most want to perform.
They invite players to debate the meaning of section cards.
They organize which players rehearse in each room and slot.

exp.trans: 指挥把乐手可到场的时间写在卡片上，放入房间与时间表以避免排练冲突；乐手在另一个会议上建议新曲目。卡片发挥什么作用？
exp.structure: marks...places...to prevent给出动作与目的链；at a separate meeting把提出曲目的行为放在另一个活动中。
exp.meaning: 卡片用于人员、地点与时间的安排；讨论曲目不因文中同时出现音乐相关词就成为卡片的功能。
exp.rest: sharing opinions与debate改成讨论行为；record which new pieces误把时间可用性换成曲目偏好，均改变了动作对象。

target: 改选证据强度：语义证据优于词面重合
skill: 改选证据强度：语义证据优于词面重合
q: An orienteering club gives walkers a "route card" on which they mark completed checkpoints. At meetings, members exchange views about route difficulty. A reader first selects "recording progress", then prefers "exchanging views on route cards" for its repeated words. Which detail should control the choice?
o: Walkers put checkpoint marks on their cards during the walk.
The meetings discuss routes using a closely related noun.
The two answer choices contain similar numbers of words.
The later answer came to mind after reading the text again.

exp.trans: 定向活动给行走者卡片，用来标记已通过的检查点；会议另讨论路线难度。读者因重复词而想把记录进度改成交流路线卡观点。应以哪条细节判断？
exp.structure: on which引出卡片上的具体动作；at meetings转入另一场合。要核对谁在何处对什么做了什么，而非只看route重复。
exp.meaning: 检查点标记直接支持记录完成进度；会议存在并不证明卡片是交换观点的讨论对象。初选受支持，是因为具体证据，不是因为它更早出现。
exp.rest: closely related noun只证明词汇相关；numbers of words是形式线索；later...again只是判断发生得晚，都没有推翻卡片用于记录这一语义证据。

target: 正确改选也要有正确理由
skill: 正确改选也要有正确理由
q: A notice says a library is launching a "lending circle". A reader initially expects book loans. The full definition says the circle meets to debate borrowing rules and issues no books itself. Which response and reason are warranted?
o: Revise, since later sentences always replace earlier ones.
Keep, since a familiar word fixes the purpose on its own.
Revise, since the full definition identifies rule discussion.
Keep, since initial answers are generally more reliable.

exp.trans: 图书馆推出lending circle，读者起初以为是借书活动；完整定义说明这是讨论借阅规则的小组，本身不发书。哪种处理及理由成立？
exp.structure: The full definition明确限定名称指什么；issues no books排除把它理解为放贷或发书服务。
exp.other: notice通知；issue在此为发出、提供；warranted有依据的。
exp.meaning: 新语义证据可推翻基于名称的初步理解。本题确实应改选；不能把此前一次正确改错总结成永远相信初选。
exp.rest: later sentences always虽选了修改，却用了错误的普遍规则；familiar word与initial answers都让词面或时间顺序压过清楚定义。

q: An apprentice knows how to repair clocks but doubts her ability. The instructor wants the next task to ___ her confidence; she is not being asked to brag about past work. Which verb fits?
o: boast
roast
boost
toast

exp.trans: 学徒会修钟表，却缺乏信心。老师希望下个任务提高她的信心，并非让她夸耀旧成绩。哪个动词合适？
exp.structure: 空格动词直接支配her confidence，要求表达提高；boast about才通常引出夸耀的对象。
exp.meaning: boost confidence表示提高信心；boast与boost字形相近但不能互换。
exp.rest: boast表示夸耀或拥有值得自豪之物，不表示提高信心；roast是烘烤，toast可烤面包或祝酒，都不符合此宾语关系。

q: A brochure says the museum "boasts a rare textile archive". A new grant will "boost access" by paying for longer opening hours. What is the distinction?
o: The museum has a valued collection; the grant improves access.
The museum increases the collection; the grant praises access.
The museum brags about visitors; the grant stores their records.
The museum sells its old textiles; the grant cuts their price.

exp.trans: 手册说博物馆boasts珍贵纺织档案；新资助通过延长开放时间boost access。两词有什么区别？
exp.structure: boasts后直接接具有吸引力的收藏，采用拥有义；boost支配access，表示提高可接近程度。
exp.meaning: boast不仅有夸耀义，还可表示拥有值得自豪之物；它仍不能泛译为增加。boost表示改善或提升。
exp.rest: increases...praises把拥有与提升两种语义互换；brags about visitors改了原宾语；sells...cuts their price添加文中没有的出售和降价。

target: 未确认形近词联想：按语境区分
skill: 未确认形近词联想：按语境区分
q: At a café, a faster oven is expected to ___ service. At dinner, the owner raises a glass for a ___ to the kitchen team. Which pair fits both sentences?
o: boast / roast
toast / boast
roast / boost
boost / toast

exp.trans: 咖啡馆的新烤箱预计能改善服务；晚餐时店主举杯向厨房团队祝酒。哪组词分别合适？
exp.structure: 第一个空格是支配service的动词，要求提升；a后接名词，raises a glass提供祝酒语境。
exp.meaning: boost可改善服务，a toast是祝酒。roast/toast在此作为教学辨析候选，不能据本题反推用户当时回忆的究竟是哪一个。
exp.rest: boast不能表达提高服务；roast表示烤制，不等于提高；toast放在service前也不能表达改善。形近不代表能共享句法宾语。

q: A museum adds guards to beef up security. Its guides practise listening exercises to sharpen their skills. Which pair preserves the two meanings?
o: Praise protection / announce new skills
Strengthen protection / improve skills
Define protection / share past skills
Remove protection / limit new skills

exp.trans: 博物馆增加安保人员以加强保卫；讲解员做听力练习以磨炼技能。哪组含义正确？
exp.structure: adds guards为beef up的增强义提供动作证据；practise...to sharpen说明练习用于提高技能。
exp.other: guard安保人员；security保卫；listening exercise听力练习。
exp.meaning: beef up与sharpen skills可在增强能力这一语境近义；不把beef或sharpen一律按食物或磨刀直译。
exp.rest: Praise/announce只是称赞或宣布；Define/share只是定义或分享；Remove/limit反转了增强方向。

target: distrust：不信任与已证实欺骗分开
skill: distrust：不信任与已证实欺骗分开
q: After repeated invoice errors, a customer distrusts the repair shop and asks another shop to check the quote. What does distrust establish?
o: She has proved that the owner knowingly deceived her.
She lacks confidence in the reliability of the shop.
She has agreed to trust every future bill from the shop.
She wants the shop to stop offering repairs to everyone.

exp.trans: 发票多次出错后，顾客不信任维修店，并请另一家核对报价。distrust能说明什么？
exp.structure: distrust直接支配the repair shop；asks another shop显示她希望再作核查，但未证明错误是否出于故意。
exp.meaning: distrust表示缺乏信任，不等于已经证实蓄意欺骗；不从态度擅自添加事实。
exp.rest: proved...knowingly把怀疑扩大为定罪式结论；trust every future bill方向相反；stop repairs添加停止经营的愿望。

q: Hikers initially mistrusted a route map because several paths were missing. Field checks and corrections gradually reduced their distrust. What changed?
o: They became less willing to consider any corrections.
They proved that every omitted path had been intentional.
They lost all interest in using maps for future walks.
Their lack of confidence in the map became less strong.

exp.trans: 徒步者因地图漏了几条路而不信任它；实地核验和修正逐渐减少了这种不信任。发生了什么变化？
exp.structure: mistrusted与distrust在此均为缺乏信任；reduced作用于负向态度，所以不信任减弱。
exp.meaning: 要追踪否定词义与变化方向的组合；distrust减小不等于信任下降，也不保证信任已完全恢复。
exp.rest: less willing把态度变化方向写反；intentional添加故意漏画；lost all interest添加彻底失去兴趣。

q: A conservator has studied one tapestry for years and knows its repairs intimately. She has never met the people who made it. What does intimately describe?
o: Detailed familiarity with the object and its repairs.
A close personal friendship with the original makers.
A very quick look that reveals almost no information.
An immediate discovery made without earlier experience.

exp.trans: 修复人员研究一幅挂毯多年，深入熟悉其修补情况，却从未见过制作它的人。intimately描述什么？
exp.structure: knows...intimately的宾语是its repairs；后句排除把这里的熟悉理解为与制作者有亲密人际关系。
exp.meaning: intimately可表示深入、详细地熟悉事物；具体语境决定词义，不限定为亲密关系，也不等于immediately的即时。
exp.rest: personal friendship换成人际关系；quick look反转深入程度；immediate discovery误把intimately当成immediately并忽略多年研究。

q: Rather than relying on annual summaries, a designer spends weeks beside the workers and becomes intimately familiar with each production stage. What is emphasized?
o: The designer has developed private friendships with everyone.
The designer has learned every stage without spending time.
The designer has gained close and detailed process knowledge.
The designer has stayed remote from the work being described.

exp.trans: 设计师不只依赖年度总结，而是在工人身边观察数周，深入熟悉各个生产阶段。强调什么？
exp.structure: Rather than构成间接概要与贴近观察的对比；familiar with后是生产阶段，不是私人交往。
exp.other: production stage生产阶段；remote疏远的、远离的。
exp.meaning: intimately familiar强调近距离、深入的了解；经历与细节是重点，不是保证所有人都成了朋友。
exp.rest: private friendships偷换为人际关系；without spending time忽略数周投入；stayed remote与在工人身边相反。

target: be conscious of / be aware of
skill: be conscious of / be aware of
q: The editor is conscious of the noise from the next room and moves the recording session. Which paraphrase preserves conscious of?
o: The editor deliberately creates all the noise in the next room.
The editor is unconscious while the recording takes place.
The editor is aware of the noise and adjusts the arrangement.
The editor knows nothing about the noise during recording.

exp.trans: 编辑意识到隔壁噪声，便调整录音安排。conscious of如何改写？
exp.structure: be conscious of后接所察觉的对象；moves the session说明意识到噪声之后的调整，不说明他制造了噪声。
exp.meaning: conscious of是意识到、察觉到，不只是生理清醒；aware of保留这一关系。
exp.rest: creates偷换为制造噪声；unconscious方向相反；knows nothing也否定了已经意识到。

target: conscious choice与conscious of的搭配区别
skill: conscious choice与conscious of的搭配区别
q: A shopper makes a conscious choice to repair a bag after comparing costs and waste. The choice was considered in advance. What does conscious mean here?
o: Deliberate and made with awareness of the alternatives.
Accidental and made without noticing any alternatives.
Made instantly, with no comparison of possible options.
Evidence that the bag was selected by another person.

exp.trans: 购物者比较费用与废弃物后，有意识地选择修包，而且事先考虑过。这里conscious是什么意思？
exp.structure: conscious修饰choice；considered in advance解释这是经过意识与考虑的选择。
exp.other: alternative可选方案；deliberate有意的、经过考虑的。
exp.meaning: conscious随搭配可指意识到或有意识、刻意的；conscious choice不同于be conscious of，但都不应机械译为清醒着。
exp.rest: accidental与有意识的考虑相反；instantly...no comparison忽略事先比较；another person把选择主体换成他人，均未保留经过考虑的选择。

q: A music club calls its chair an over-tweeting organizer: members find the stream of brief posts excessive. What does over-tweeting describe?
o: An organizer who has permanently stopped publishing posts.
An organizer whose every post has been proved to be false.
An organizer who publishes only after an event has ended.
An organizer who publishes brief posts too frequently.

exp.trans: 音乐社团称负责人发帖过于频繁，成员觉得不断出现的短帖太多。over-tweeting描述什么？
exp.structure: over-为过度前缀；members find...excessive直接说明频率评价，而非真假或时间先后。
exp.other: chair负责人；stream不断出现的一连串；excessive过多的。
exp.meaning: over-tweeting关注发推文过多或过频，不能从该形容词推出每条内容都是假的。
exp.rest: stopped把过度反成停止；every...false添加真假结论；after...ended把over当成结束后的时间关系。

q: One reviewer calls a handbook over-detailed; another calls the author over-tweeting. The first comment concerns detail, the second posting. What does over- add in both?
o: The activity has been completely finished for the day.
The amount or frequency is judged greater than suitable.
The activity must take place physically above the reader.
The content has been confirmed correct by every reader.

exp.trans: 一人批评手册细节过多，另一人说作者发帖过频。前缀over-在两处增加什么含义？
exp.structure: over-分别作用于detailed与tweeting；比较对象分别为细节量与发布频率，共通的是超过合适程度。
exp.meaning: 可组合前缀可迁移，但超过多少取决于语境评价；不能硬解为已经结束、在上方或真实性认证。
exp.rest: finished是另一种over用法但不适合前缀；above误成空间；confirmed correct添加未经表达的准确性。
